usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a coherent picture of Amon: Qualcomm CEO, engineer who joined in 1995 and rose to the top, Brazilian background, current strategic priorities (6G, robotics, data centers), and a quotable leadership principle. Understanding is solid but limited to a single Yahoo Finance interview, so depth is moderate. The dossier does not explicitly state what it does not know; the 'contested' and 'claimed' statuses hint at uncertainty but there is no articulation of open questions or gaps. Conversation readiness is decent — a reader knows his role, trajectory, priorities, and leadership style — but lacks specifics on recent results, challenges, or current compensation. Notably, none of the listed unjustified conclusions (sole 5G invention, current $23.5M pay, Summit announcement verification) correspond to any statement actually present in this dossier, so there is nothing to match them against.
